summary: Iteration 28: checked that the 99 app (app99/99app) and its radar were removed. Backend: the full suite run with pytest -n0 --ignore=tests/_old passed 169/169 (the 163 existing tests plus 6 new ones in test_app99_removed.py). A 7th test was added later and passes. GET /api/settings returns only rapido, moove and urbano, with no radar fields. A legacy settings doc that has apps.app99 and radar fields is cleaned on read, and app99 is $unset in Mongo. The mixed case (app99 present, urbano missing) works with $unset and $set in one update. PUT apps.app99, GET /rides?app=app99 and POST /rides/bulk with app99 or source 99app all return 422. Legacy app99 rides are left out of /rides and /rides/summary. Frontend (web, 390x844), using a legacy doc with app99 enabled and an app99 ride: the Painel shows 3 cards and no app-card-app99. The master button shows ONLINE 1/3, then OFF-LINE, then ONLINE when all 3 are on, then ONLINE 2/3. Filtros shows 3 segments and no radar section, and Salvar returns 'Filtros salvos'. Histórico shows 3 chips and 3 rows; the app99 ride is hidden. /aprender shows 3 segments. The login subtitle and the aviso screen do not mention 99. Kotlin review of RideAccessibilityService.kt by reading only (no kotlinc here): every radar, RADAR_APP, radarTick, findAllLabeled and swipeDown reference is gone. currentBusy() compiles and returns String?. tap() and clickNode() are still used. Two issues found: (1) aprender.tsx:112 still says 'Abra o RapidoCar ou a 99' (only shown on the native APK). (2) app99 ride events already queued on a driver's phone are not filtered before upload, so they block ride-history sync.

minor.issue: Legacy top-level fields radar_enabled and radar_interval_s stay in the Mongo settings doc. Only apps.app99 is $unset. The API does not return them, so this only leaves stale data.

ui_bugs.issue: The text still mentions the 99 app: '2. Abra o RapidoCar ou a 99 na tela desejada.' It is only visible on the native APK (nativeAvailable), so the web preview does not show it. Reference: /app/frontend/app/aprender.tsx:112

integration_issues.flow: Native ride-event sync (Painel focus -> takePendingEvents -> uploadRides)
integration_issues.issue: takePendingEvents() returns every queued native event without filtering. A driver who updates while app99/99app events are still queued on the phone sends them to POST /rides/bulk. The whole batch then gets 422, so clearPendingEvents() never runs. Ride-history sync stays blocked until the 99 events age out of the MAX_EVENTS ring buffer, and the oldest valid events are lost when that happens. test_mixed_bulk_with_app99_rejected_whole_batch shows the 422 for a mixed batch. Reference: /app/frontend/src/native/rideFilter.ts:84-87 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:72-79

action_items: Change /app/frontend/app/aprender.tsx:112 to something like 'Abra o RapidoCar, MooveCar ou Urbano Norte na tela desejada.'

In takePendingEvents() (src/native/rideFilter.ts), filter queued events with APP_KEYS.includes(e.app), and optionally check that source is one of rapidocar, moovecar or urbanonorte. Otherwise old app99 events make every uploadRides batch fail with 422.
Optional: also $unset the top-level radar_enabled and radar_interval_s in get_settings when they exist.
Optional: update the stale KDoc in RideAccessibilityService.kt (lines 33 and 180), which mentions only RapidoCar and MooveCar.
critical_code_review_comments: RideAccessibilityService.kt, read only (not compiled): no references to radar, RADAR_APP, radarTick, findAllLabeled or swipeDown remain. onServiceConnected sets instance and calls applyPackageFilter. onDestroy sets instance=null and calls super. APP_KEYS, APP_LABELS and APP_SOURCES each have 3 entries.

currentBusy() line 132: String.ifEmpty { null } has type String?. ?.takeIf { it in APP_KEYS } is String?. ?: run { RideFilterStore.clearBusy(this); null } uses the receiver-less run, so `this` is the service (a Context), and clearBusy(context: Context) exists. The return type is String?, so it should compile. An empty or unknown busy app also clears the busy state, which is the intended behaviour.
tap() is still used by clickNode() (fallback) and by retryIfStillShown(). clickNode() is used for accept and reject. GestureDescription, Path and Rect are still used by tap().
There are no references to radar or app99 in RideFilterModule.kt, RideFilterStore.kt, the accessibility XML, src/ or app/, except aprender.tsx:112 (text) and a comment in rideFilter.ts.
server.py: APP_KEY_LIST is used consistently in AppKey, the list_rides $in filter, the summary $match and the get_settings cleanup.

success_rate.backend: 100% (169/169 in the full run; the 7th test_app99_removed test, added later, also passes)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all web checks pass; 1 native-only text bug and 1 native sync integration risk found by code review)

seed_data_creation: I created one TEST_no99_ui driver (with a legacy app99 settings doc and 4 rides) through ui_seed_iter28.py and removed it by id afterwards. Importing ui_seed_iter26 by mistake ran its module-level seed and created 6 TEST_web_* users. I deleted them right away by id with 'ui_seed_iter26.py clean'. 0 TEST_ users are left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend with: cd /app/backend && pytest tests -n0 --ignore=tests/_old (the base URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env). test_radar_99*.py were deleted, and test_app99_removed.py is the regression test for the removal. Web login binds device_id, so set users.device_id=null before each new browser context. Do NOT import ui_seed_iter*.py modules: they run seed/clean when imported.
rca_of_issue: Queued-event 422: RideIn.app is Literal[rapido, moove, urbano], so Pydantic rejects the whole List[RideIn] if any item is app99. The JS sync keeps events on any error, so the old events retry and fail on every focus. Fix: filter on the client in takePendingEvents.
